required_action: Run a strict independent semantic review of the three design documents against story/spec/acceptance. Actively check for: references to commands, tools or paths that do not exist (unmarked as to-be-created); author self-certified checklists; placeholder or generic content in contract fields (e.g. evidence columns without concrete commands/outputs); ground truth applicability (absent-but-justified if test-plan §3 says not applicable; else present/minimal/runnable/isolated - not a feature-complete reference implementation); the host engineering quality-guard stack. Anchor every blocking finding as a discussion thread via trac discuss start and return REVISE; pass only when the design is genuinely closed.
